# Copilot repository instructions

The Store Insights React frontend lives in `projects/wiq-si-portal/frontend`;
run its commands from that directory. The
[project guide](../projects/wiq-si-portal/README.md) describes the monorepo
layout, Cloud Build paths and branches.

Read and follow the frontend's
[AGENTS.md](../projects/wiq-si-portal/frontend/AGENTS.md) as the shared
repository guide before making changes. It defines the migration goal, module
boundaries, parity constraints, test commands and safety rules.

Read the relevant
[architecture decisions](../projects/wiq-si-portal/frontend/docs/decisions/README.md)
and guides from the
[documentation hub](../projects/wiq-si-portal/frontend/docs/README.md), including
the feature assessment linked from the shared guide. Treat dated migration
plans as historical intent, not proof of the current implementation.

Keep repository guidance in `AGENTS.md` and decision records rather than
duplicating it here. Do not assume Markdown links automatically load their
targets; open the relevant files when they are not already in context.
